effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[When Digivolving] If a Tamer card with the [DigiPolice] trait is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon or Tamers to the bottom of the deck.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon becomes suspended, you may play 1 Digimon card with the [Beast Dragon] or [DigiPolice] trait and 5000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.
